dublinCore.dc:rights: Pursuant to Title 17 Section 105 of the United States Code, this file is not subject to copyright protection and is in the public domain.

action.action-desc: Mr. Cisneros (for himself and Mr. Carter of Louisiana) introduced the following bill; which was referred to the Committee on Energy and Commerce

form.official-title: To reauthorize appropriations for the advanced drinking water technology grant program under the Safe Drinking Water Act, and for other purposes.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the Water Technology and Resilience Reauthorization Act.
Section 1459G(b)(5)(A) of the Safe Drinking Water Act is amended by striking 2022 through 2026 and inserting 2027 through 2031.
